entries.source: Projects up to %d attacks dealing 30%% weapon damage to other random targets in range 7 as mind damage (1/turn)
entries.target: 朝周围7格范围内的其他随机目标投射至多 %d 次攻击，每次造成 30%% 精神武器伤害（1次/回合）

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#50%%#LAST# chance to put 1 talent on cooldown for #YELLOW#%d#LAST# turns (checks Confusion immunity)
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#50%%#LAST#几率将一个技能打入#YELLOW#%d#LAST#回合冷却（需通过混乱免疫）

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#20%#LAST# chance to stun, blind, pin, confuse, or silence the target for 3 turns
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#20%#LAST#几率震慑、混乱、沉默、定身或致盲目标3回合

entries.source: A length of troll intestines. Fortunately, the troll appears to have eaten nothing in some time.
entries.target: 一截巨魔肠子。幸运的是，这只巨魔似乎已经有一段时间没吃东西了。

entries.source: The skull of a skeleton mage. The eyes have stopped glowing... for now.
entries.target: 一颗骷髅法师的头骨。现在……它的眼睛已经暗淡了。

entries.source: A ritch stinger, still glistening with venom.
entries.target: 一根里奇的螫针，仍闪着毒液的光泽。

entries.source: The heart of an orc. Perhaps surprisingly, it isn't green.
entries.target: 一颗兽人的心脏。很惊讶吧，它不是绿色的。

entries.source: A severed naga tongue. It reeks of brine.
entries.target: 一截娜迦的舌头。它散发着海水的气息。

entries.source: A vial of greater demon bile. It hurts your sinuses even with the vial's stopper firmly in place.
entries.target: 一瓶大恶魔的胆汁。尽管有着良好的阻隔，它仍刺激着你的鼻窦。

entries.source: Once the magics animating the bone giant fled, its remains crumbled to dust. It might be your imagination, but it looks like the dust occasionally stirs on its own.
entries.target: 当操纵骨巨人的魔法力量消散后，它的遗骸化为了尘土。也许是你的幻觉，但这些尘土似乎偶尔会自行移动。

entries.source: Wickedly sharp and still freezing cold.
entries.target: 异乎寻常的锋利且散发着阵阵寒气。

entries.source: The severed front half of a minotaur snout, ring and all.
entries.target: 从米诺陶口鼻部割下来的前半截，连鼻环一起。
一瓶长老吸血鬼的血液

entries.source: Thick, clotted, and foul. The vial is cold to the touch.
entries.target: 粘稠的、凝固的、污秽的液体。瓶子摸起来很冷。

entries.source: Beautiful and nearly impregnable. Separating it from the dragon must have been hard work.
entries.target: 美丽且异常坚固的龙鳞。把它从龙身上扒下来一定费了不少力气。

entries.source: An ugly, ripped-out chunk of giant spider. Bits of silk protrude from an orifice.
entries.target: 从巨型蜘蛛身上扯下的一大块丑陋的器官，少量的丝线从某个洞中伸出。

entries.source: The severed end of one of a honey tree's roots. It wriggles around occasionally, seemingly unwilling to admit that it's dead... and a *plant*.
entries.target: 从蜂蜜树的一根树根上切下来的断端。它偶尔会蠕动下，似乎不承认它已经死了，而且还是个“植物”。

entries.source: Diseased-looking and reeking. It seems to be decaying as you watch.
entries.target: 病变且散发着恶臭的心脏，在你注视它时似乎仍在腐烂。

entries.source: Slimy, wriggling, and crackling with electricity.
entries.target: 黏滑、蠕动的尾巴，还闪着噼啪作响的电火花。
巨大的、长有利爪的脚掌

entries.source: Large and hairy with flesh-rending claws. It smells slightly of fish.
entries.target: 体型巨大、浑身长毛，还有能撕裂血肉的利爪。它闻起来略带鱼腥味。

entries.source: This tooth has been blunted with age, but still looks more than capable of doing its job.
entries.target: 这颗牙齿饱受岁月的侵蚀，但是仍然能胜任它的工作。

entries.source: Tiny flames still dance ethereally inside this transparent crystal, though its heat seems to have faded... you hope.
entries.target: 小巧的火焰依然在这颗透明的水晶里轻盈舞动，尽管它的热量似乎已经消退……你希望如此。
